provider.guide.jobber.cost: Free. Each business connects its own Jobber account. A draft Jobber app works for up to 5 paying Jobber accounts; more need Jobber’s app review.
provider.guide.jobber.step1: At developer.getjobber.com: sign up for a developer account, then Apps › New app (integrations/jobber/README.md of the Linedesk repo has every field).
provider.guide.jobber.step2: OAuth Callback URL: the redirect URL shown below. Scopes: Clients, read and write. Keep refresh token rotation on.
provider.guide.jobber.step3: Save the app, then copy its client ID and client secret and paste them here.
provider.guide.privacy.assemblyai: Dashboard › Data Controls: turn on Opt Out of Data Sharing for Model Improvement Program (paid plans), so AssemblyAI does not train on the recordings.
provider.guide.privacy.elevenlabs: Profile › Terms and privacy › Data use: turn it off. Otherwise ElevenLabs may train on what you send, calls included (plans below Enterprise).
provider.guide.privacy.gemini: Turn on billing for the key’s Google Cloud project: Google may use what free-tier keys send to improve its products, calls included.
provider.guide.privacy.mistral: Use the paid Scale plan: on the free Experiment plan Mistral may train on what you send, calls included (admin.mistral.ai › Privacy turns it off).
provider.guide.privacy.openrouter: Settings › Privacy: turn off providers that may train on your inputs. Linedesk asks for that on every request too; this is a second safety net.
provider.guide.shopify.cost: Free. Each business connects its own Shopify store. An app not listed in the Shopify App Store installs by link; reading customer names, emails, phones and addresses on a store that is not a development store needs Shopify's protected customer data approval.
provider.guide.shopify.step1: At dev.shopify.com: create a Partner account, then Apps › Create app › Create app manually (integrations/shopify/README.md of the Linedesk repo has every field).
provider.guide.shopify.step2: Configuration: App URL and Allowed redirection URL: the redirect URL shown below. Embedded in Shopify admin: off. Under API access, request protected customer data access (name, email, phone, address).
provider.guide.shopify.step3: Copy the client ID and client secret from the app's overview and paste them here.
provider.guide.slack.cost: Free. Each business connects its own Slack, on any Slack plan.
provider.guide.slack.step1: At api.slack.com/apps: Create New App › From a manifest, pick any Slack workspace of yours, and paste integrations/slack/manifest.json of the Linedesk repo (change the redirect URL to the one shown below, and the events URL to this server’s).
provider.guide.slack.step2: Manage Distribution › Activate Public Distribution, so other Slack workspaces can install it.
provider.guide.slack.step3: Basic Information › App Credentials: copy the client ID, the client secret and the signing secret and paste them here.
provider.guide.slack.step4: Event Subscriptions: once the signing secret is saved here, set the request URL to this server’s address followed by /v1/apps/events/slack, so an uninstall in Slack shows at once.
provider.guide.zoho.cost: Free. Each business connects its own Zoho CRM; Zoho counts the API calls against that business's own Zoho CRM plan.
provider.guide.zoho.step1: At api-console.zoho.com: Add Client › Server-based Applications. Homepage URL: this server's address. Authorized Redirect URIs: the redirect URL shown below.
provider.guide.zoho.step2: In the client's Settings tab, turn on every data centre (Multi-DC) and tick “Use the same OAuth credentials for all data centers”, so businesses whose Zoho account is in the EU, India, Australia or another region can connect too.
provider.guide.zoho.step3: Copy the client ID and client secret from the Client Secret tab and paste them here.
provider.help.assemblyai_stt: The assistant answers when AssemblyAI says the caller is done. With Wait for callers to finish on (the default), it waits as long as Deepgram Flux does. Off, it answers about a quarter of a second sooner, but it often starts while the caller only pauses (before a house number, for example). It can’t understand Polish, Ukrainian, Czech, Greek, Hungarian or Indonesian: with Deepgram set up too, calls in these languages use Deepgram (Nova-3); without it, assistants are not offered them.
provider.help.cloudflare_saas: Lets white-label partners give their clients an address of their own, like app.theiragency.com. Partners point their address at the CNAME target.
provider.help.google_mail: A Google OAuth app with the Gmail API, the gmail.readonly scope and the redirect URI below. Businesses then connect their Gmail support mailbox under Integrations, read only. Microsoft 365 mailboxes use the Microsoft sign-in app (Mail.Read).
provider.help.jobber: A Jobber app with the redirect URL below and the client scopes (read and write). Businesses then connect their Jobber under Integrations, and every finished phone call is added as a note on the caller’s Jobber client.
provider.help.openrouter: Calls only go to providers that don’t train on them. With Zero data retention only (on by default) they also only go to endpoints that keep nothing after answering, which leaves fewer providers for some models. You can turn it off: some providers then keep requests for a while, for example for abuse checks, and your privacy notice may need to say so.
provider.help.shopify: A Shopify app with the redirect URL below. Businesses then connect their store under Integrations: the assistant can look up orders and products during calls, and every finished phone call is added as a note on the Shopify customer.
provider.help.zoho: A Zoho API console client (server-based, every data centre on, one secret for all) with the redirect URL below. Businesses then connect their Zoho CRM under Integrations, and every finished phone call is logged on the caller's Zoho CRM contact.
